name: A cardiac arrest
prompt: A man of sixty is down on his kitchen floor, not breathing. His wife started compressions before you came through the door.

choices.text: Take over compressions and run the protocol as trained

outcome.told: You work him for twenty minutes and bring him in with a pulse. Nobody knows yet if he'll wake.

choices.text: Load him and work him in the back on the way

outcome.told: You get him to the doors four minutes sooner, with a rhythm on the monitor.

failure.told: Compressions in a moving rig are shallow. He arrives without a pulse, and the doctor calls it at the doors.
